1: // Simple Canvas Escape game
2: const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
3: if (!canvas) throw new Error('Canvas with id "game" not found');
4: const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
5: canvas.width = canvas.clientWidth || 400;
6: canvas.height = canvas.clientHeight || 600;
7: 
8: // Player
9: const player = {x: canvas.width/2-15, y: canvas.height-60, w:30, h:30, vx:0, vy:0};
10: const speed = 4;
11: const boost = -8;
12: const gravity = 0.3;
13: 
14: // Obstacles
15: let obstacles = [];
16: function addObstacle(){
17:   const w = 50+Math.random()*100;
18:   const gap = 80+Math.random()*120;
19:   const x = Math.random()*(canvas.width-w);
20:   obstacles.push({x, y:-gap, w, h:gap, speed:2+Math.random()*2});
21: }
22: let obstacleTimer=0;
23: 
24: function update(){
25:   // player movement
26:   if (keys['ArrowLeft']) player.vx = -speed;
27:   else if (keys['ArrowRight']) player.vx = speed;
28:   else player.vx = 0;
29:   if (keys['Space']) player.vy = boost;
30: 
31:   player.vy += gravity;
32:   player.x += player.vx;
33:   player.y += player.vy;
34:   // bounds
35:   if (player.x<0) player.x=0;
36:   if (player.x+player.w>canvas.width) player.x=canvas.width-player.w;
37:   // lose if falls below screen
38:   if (player.y+player.h>canvas.height) gameOver();
39: 
40:   // obstacles move down
41:   obstacles.forEach(o=>{o.y+=o.speed});
42:   // remove off‑screen
43:   obstacles = obstacles.filter(o=>o.y<canvas.height);
44: 
45:   // spawn
46:   obstacleTimer++; if(obstacleTimer>120){obstacleTimer=0; addObstacle();}
47: 
48:   // collision detection
49:   for (let o of obstacles){
50:     if (player.x < o.x+o.w && player.x+player.w > o.x &&
51:         player.y < o.y+o.h && player.y+player.h > o.y) {
52:       gameOver();
53:     }
54:   }
55: }
56: 
57: function draw(){
58:   ctx.clearRect(0,0,canvas.width,canvas.height);
59:   ctx.fillStyle='steelblue';
60:   ctx.fillRect(player.x,player.y,player.w,player.h);
61:   ctx.fillStyle='crimson';
62:   obstacles.forEach(o=>ctx.fillRect(o.x,o.y,o.w,o.h));
63: }
64: 
65: let animationId;
66: function loop(){
67:   update();
68:   draw();
69:   animationId = requestAnimationFrame(loop);
70: }
71: function gameOver(){
72:   cancelAnimationFrame(animationId);
73:   alert('Game Over');
74:   // reset
75:   player.x = canvas.width/2-15; player.y = canvas.height-60; player.vx=0; player.vy=0;
76:   obstacles=[]; obstacleTimer=0; animationId=requestAnimationFrame(loop);
77: }
78: 
79: const keys={};
80: window.addEventListener('keydown',e=>{keys[e.key]=true;});
81: window.addEventListener('keyup',e=>{keys[e.key]=false;});
82: 
83: animationId = requestAnimationFrame(loop);
